benchmark.datasets: Use two comparable synthetic packets, A and B. Do not reuse a packet already seen by the timed reviewer.
conditions: Generic chatbot with the same packet
measure: target impacts found / total expected impacts
benchmark.reporting: Report reviewer count, packet size, model ID, runs, and actual measurements. Small demonstrations do not establish production accuracy. If baseline comparison cannot be completed, say improvement remains unmeasured.
